featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Naturals Ice Cream, which is situated just beside our office, so it’s usually a go-to place for many of my colleagues after lunch.

I’m honestly not a big ice cream person, but I still end up going there often with my friends because they really enjoy it.

Among the flavors I’ve tried, I really liked the Tender Coconut ice cream. The little crunch of coconut malai in it makes it taste really nice and refreshing.

I also liked the Guava flavor, especially because of that pinch of masala, which gives it a unique taste.

At this point, I don’t eat ice cream anywhere but at Naturals. Be it at their outlets or ordered in, it’s all the ice cream I eat.
I have always been a fan of their Tender Coconut Ice cream. Tubs and tubs of it but never enough!

Particularly for this outlet, I liked their interior. The crowd seemed good too. Ample seating.

Summer establishes it mandatory to have me indulge in their Sitafal flavour. I went her for just that. This time, however, I went overboard and had a cone with one scoop of Sitafal and one scoop of Jackfruit. I had never had Jackfruit, as ice cream or otherwise and it was indeed a delicious surprise.

Natural Ice Cream at Thaltej is a reliable, high-quality dessert destination. It offers a refreshing break from overly sweet or artificial ice creams. It is one of the best ways to end any meal in this part of Ahmedabad.
Purely for the ice cream quality; a little less space for seating is the only minor drawback.

I recently had the pleasure of trying the Sitafal ice cream at Naturals, and I must say it was an absolutely delightful experience!

The texture of the ice cream was perfectly creamy, and the flavor of Sitafal was rich and authentic. It had a wonderful balance of sweetness and a hint of tropical goodness that transported my taste buds to a paradise of flavors.

The ambiance of the ice cream shop added to the overall experience. It was clean, well-maintained, and had a welcoming atmosphere that made enjoying my ice cream even more enjoyable.

Tried their tender coconut & choco bite waffle.
These are the best two ice-creams one can blindly rely on. Tender coco cup will roughly cost you around 50bucks & choco bite waffle 60 incl of tax.
Unfortunately wanted to try the Muskmelon ice-cream but it wasn't available in scoop serve.

They have some amazing ice creams out there ..I have tried tender coconut, sitafal, choco walnut , choco chips, mulberry, raspberry, anjeer and choco almond... By far the must have ice creams are tender coconut and sitafal for ₹50...anjeer, mulberry, raspberry, choco almond are also good to try ... however I did not like choco walnut and choco chips ...choco walnut did not taste good it was kind of bitter and choco chips had too many choco chips ...it's a good place to try out

featured_reviews.name: Suyash Karangutkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited Gold by Ice Cream Works and had an absolutely delightful experience! We started with their 70% Dark Chocolate Ganache with Choco Rocks scoop — a dream for dark chocolate lovers. It was rich, with just the right balance of bittersweet notes, and the texture of the choco rocks added a perfect crunch, making it wonderfully pallete-balancing.

Next, we tried the Ferro Hazelnut, which was dipped in chocolate and absolutely delicious — a treat that beautifully captured the classic hazelnut and chocolate combination. As a healthier choice, we also sampled their Good-For-You Chocolate (pun game strong!) a chocolate ice cream sweetened with palm jaggery. The natural sweetness of the jaggery was spot on, making it feel indulgent yet light, and we appreciated the clever pun in the name!

The ambiance of the place was cozy and inviting, and the staff were extremely welcoming, cordial, and helpful in suggesting flavors based on our preferences. They made the experience even more enjoyable.

We also noticed an entire section dedicated to caramel ice-cream cakes, which looked very tempting — definitely on our list for the next visit! Plus, their Sundae menu is quite elaborate, offering plenty of options for those looking to indulge.

Overall, a must-visit spot for ice cream and dessert enthusiasts. Can’t wait to go back and try more!

3 Berries Cheesecake.
Biscotti Chocolate Cookie Fudge.

SUNDAES~
Chocolate in Gold Perfection.
Alphonso Mango.
They are the masters in preparing sundaes as the mix of flavours plus presentation is top class.  Chocolate in gold perfection was way too heavy for the appetite as it had everything related to chocolate in it. The best was the Alphonso mango from their limited edition menu which was outstanding.

MILKSHAKES~
Pistachio Opulence.
Alphanso Mango Milkshake.
Amazingly thick shakes made perfectly which tasted excellent. Loved the pistachio opulence and it should definitely be tried. Again not too sweet but tasty till the last drop.

Ice Creams Tried:
70% Dark Chocolate Ganache Ice Cream: Deep, intense, and a must-try for dark chocolate lovers.

Good-for-you Chocolate Ice Cream: Rich, indulgent and made up of jaggery instead of sugar.

featured_reviews.name: Saharsh
featured_reviews.review_text:
My dad has taken me to apsara ice cream many times. So I thought I should share a review of one of our many visits.

We have had many flavors of apsara ice cream over the year - them being Belgian chocolate, pineapple, Belgian chocolate, funky Ferrero, and guava glory.  Today we tried coffee flavored ice cream.
I bought one small scoop of Belgian chocolate and my dad one small scoop of ( i think it's called ) coffee crunch. Just ask them for coffee flavored ice cream and you'll be fine.
After receiving my order, I brought it back to the car where we could have a taste. And it did not disappoint, but it wasn't the best scoop either.

Starting out with Belgian chocolate - it was quite good. It wasn't deep frozen and melted in my mouth. The small bits of chocolate in the ice cream were awesome 👍. 10/10. If you can't decide what to get just get Belgian chocolate.

Next - coffee crunch. Here's when it gets bad. The ice cream itself was great, but it's texture was so hard that it wouldnt melt at all.
It was slightly hard to eat,  but that's about it

If you want reviews of some other flavors-

1. Mango - mango is a bit of a 50/50. Sometimes it's good and other times it's bad.  During the mango season, i remember having multiple mango scoops out of which only once did it actually taste like Alphonso mango ice cream. Other times it wasn't as good.

2. Orange apricot - this is a really unique and great flavour. Not as sweet as mango, but great nonetheless. There's small orange pieces inside the ice cream which taste great as well.

3. Funk Ferrero - in my opinion funky Ferrero was a bit too sugary. It tasted like a ferro rosher , sure, but that's all there is to it.

4. Brownie blast - this is by far the worst flavor you can get. I've tried this twice and both times it tasted like brownies but mixed with sour chemicals. Don't buy this at any cost.

featured_reviews.review_text: Arun Ice Creams (HAP Daily) is one of the best places to enjoy a wide variety of delicious ice creams. 🍦 The quality is always fresh, creamy, and consistent. The staff here is polite, helpful, and provides quick service. The shop is well-maintained and hygienic, which adds to the experience. Prices are also reasonable compared to the quality and options available. Apart from ice creams, they also have frozen desserts and snacks which are equally good. I really appreciate the brand for keeping up with quality standards. Perfect place to visit with family, kids, or friends. Highly recommended for all ice cream lovers! 🌟
